crop.notes: Column of unrelated sporting and news items; the Allen item is a two-line notice in crop-5 ('Tom Allen, retired champion pugilist of the world, 619 Market street. Free concert every evening.').

title.suggested: Notice for Tom Allen's Saloon at 619 Market Street

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Republic carried a notice for Tom Allen, 'retired champion pugilist of the world,' at 619 Market Street, with a free concert every evening.

metadata.notes: Masthead: The Republic: St. Louis, Mo., Saturday Morning, January 24, 1891, page 6. This version does not include 'Best of singers' (that is in 812); summary corrected.

facts.fact: Allen advertised himself as 'retired champion pugilist of the world' at 619 Market Street, St. Louis, with a free concert every evening

notes: Focus suggested primary since the item itself is entirely about Allen, though it is only a brief notice; passing is also defensible.
